Selected work

BSc thesis · May–October 2025 · Rust / C / FFI

Brickworks-rs: from DSP library to audio plugin

A Rust port of Orastron's Brickworks audio DSP library, with a distortion plugin that brings the library into a digital audio workstation.

Goal. Explore native Rust implementations alongside FFI bindings to the original C library for real-time audio processing.

My contribution. Built Rust DSP implementations and C bindings, then integrated the library into a distortion plugin using nih-plug, targeting VST3 and CLAP.

What you can explore. The library and plugin are public, with documented release builds, benchmark commands and instructions for trying the plugin in a DAW.
